title: Premium Accounting Manual: Owner Auto Policy Return Premium Methods and Arithmetic Conventions
content:
**Owner Auto Policy — return-premium methods and arithmetic conventions.**

| Package | Method on cancellation for nonpayment | Method on underwriting cancellation | Short-rate retention on insured-requested cancellation (percent of the unearned premium) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cardinal Point Minimum Limits Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 10 |
| Cardinal Point 50/100/50 Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 10 |
| Cardinal Point 100/200/50 Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 10 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/50 Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 10 |
| Cardinal Point 100/300/100 Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 0 (pure pro rata refund) |
| Cardinal Point 250/500/100 Liability | pro rata | pro rata | 0 (pure pro rata refund) |

**Method on cancellation for nonpayment.** The schedule gives the return-premium method on a cancellation for nonpayment as pro rata. For a term cancelled for nonpayment, and only for such a cancellation, the premium returned is the nonpayment return premium the company works out from the term's current full-term rate, and fully earned fees are not returned. An underwriting cancellation is still returned in full pro rata.

**Short-rate retention percentage.** The schedule gives this as the percent of the unearned premium the company retains when the named insured requests cancellation, where 0 means a pure pro rata refund. For a cancellation at the insured's request, and only for that cancellation, the premium returned is the insured-request return premium the company works out, and fully earned fees are not returned. A cancellation for nonpayment keeps its own rule. An underwriting cancellation keeps the transaction-by-transaction pro rata computation and is returned in full pro rata.

**Conventions common to every package.**
- **Day count for pro rata arithmetic:** the actual calendar days from the term's effective date to its expiration date.
- **Rounding:** every computed premium or refund is rounded to the nearest cent, half up.
- **Crediting a refund:** any unearned premium credit is applied to the billing plan within 15 calendar days after the cancellation is processed.

**Hypothetical illustrations of the conventions.**
- A term effective on the 1st of January and expiring on the 1st of July of a non-leap year counts 181 days.
- An amount of 47.125 rounds to 47.13.
